robots.text: Robot vacuum_1 is a vacuum robot. It removes dry dirt on tile and carpet.
Robot mop_1 is a mopping robot. It wet-cleans tile floors only.
Robot scout_1 has a camera and detects dirt. It cannot clean.

rules: Dry dirt on tile is cleaned in two steps: first vacuum, then mop.
Wet dirt on tile is only mopped.
Never send a mopping robot onto a carpet.
